name: ai-treasury-security
description: Person B execution plane: PolicyVault, verified swap simulation and PDR relay

scripts.setup: uv sync --locked && uv sync --project apps/execution-plane --locked && uv run --locked python scripts/bootstrap.py
scripts.compile: uv run --locked python scripts/foundry.py forge build
scripts.anvil: uv run --locked python scripts/foundry.py anvil --host 127.0.0.1 --chain-id 31337 --hardfork cancun
scripts.deploy:local: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli deploy-local
scripts.deploy:fuji: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli deploy-fuji
scripts.demo: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli demo
scripts.local: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli start-local
scripts.dev: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli serve
scripts.dev:local: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli serve --network local
scripts.dev:fuji: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli serve --network fuji
scripts.config: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli config
scripts.config:fuji: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli config --network fuji
scripts.test:contracts: uv run --locked python scripts/foundry.py forge test -vv
scripts.test:consumer: npm run compile && uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m pytest tests/test_consumer_contract.py -q
scripts.test:ab: npm run compile && uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m pytest tests/test_ab_integration.py -q
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:python && npm run test:integration
scripts.schemas: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli schemas
scripts.fixtures: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli fixtures
scripts.golden: uv run --directory apps/execution-plane python -m app.cli golden
scripts.treasury:doctor: uv run --locked python scripts/treasury.py doctor --network fuji --live
scripts.treasury:deploy:fuji: uv run --locked python scripts/treasury.py deploy --network fuji
scripts.treasury:prepare:fuji: uv run --locked python scripts/treasury.py prepare --network fuji
scripts.treasury:fuji: uv run --locked python scripts/treasury.py serve --network fuji
scripts.treasury:demo:fuji: uv run --locked python scripts/treasury.py demo --network fuji
scripts.treasury:renew:fuji: uv run --locked python scripts/treasury.py renew-session --network fuji
